constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_heads_v1_c1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((purpose_code = 'OPERATIONAL_AGENT_CONTEXT_V1'::text) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_heads_v1_c2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((head_revision >= 1) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_heads_v1_f1
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id) REFERENCES gov_repo.sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1(organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id)

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_heads_v1_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (organisation_id, source_record_id, purpose_code)

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((subject_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(gov_repo.frame_identity(ARRAY['GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_SUBJECT_V1'::text, (organisation_id)::text, 'LEGACY_AGENT_RECORD'::text, (source_record_id)::text]), 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c10
constraints.definition: CHECK (((observation_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(gov_repo.frame_identity(ARRAY['GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_AGENT_OBSERVATION_V1'::text, (organisation_id)::text, (source_record_id)::text, subject_id, source_descriptor_recipe, source_descriptor_fingerprint, acquisition_method_code, acquisition_method_version, projection_recipe_id, projection_recipe_version, projection_schema_version, projection_id, handling_recipe_id, handling_recipe_version, document_recipe]), 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c11
constraints.definition: CHECK (((isfinite(observed_at) AND isfinite(recorded_at) AND (observed_at <= recorded_at)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_descriptor_recipe = 'GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_AGENT_SOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_V1'::text) AND (source_descriptor_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((octet_length(acquisition_method_code) >= 1) AND (octet_length(acquisition_method_code) <= 512)) AND (acquisition_method_code ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (acquisition_method_code !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND ((octet_length(acquisition_method_version) >= 1) AND (octet_length(acquisition_method_version) <= 512)) AND (acquisition_method_version ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (acquisition_method_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (lower(btrim(acquisition_method_version)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text]))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((projection_recipe_id = 'GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_AGENT_PROJECTION_V1'::text) AND (projection_recipe_version = '1'::text) AND (handling_recipe_id = 'GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_HANDLING_V1'::text) AND (handling_recipe_version = '1'::text) AND (document_recipe = 'GOVIA_OPERATIONAL_CONTEXT_V1'::text) AND ((octet_length(projection_schema_version) >= 1) AND (octet_length(projection_schema_version) <= 512)) AND (projection_schema_version ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (projection_schema_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (lower(btrim(projection_schema_version)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text]))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c5
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((octet_length(agent_code_label) >= 1) AND (octet_length(agent_code_label) <= 512)) AND (agent_code_label ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (agent_code_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND ((octet_length(agent_name_label) >= 1) AND (octet_length(agent_name_label) <= 512)) AND (agent_name_label ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (agent_name_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c6
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((business_domain_label IS NULL) OR (((octet_length(business_domain_label) >= 1) AND (octet_length(business_domain_label) <= 512)) AND (business_domain_label ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (business_domain_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c7
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((description_disposition = 'WITHHELD'::text) AND (description_text IS NULL)) OR ((description_disposition = 'PROJECTED'::text) AND ((octet_length(description_text) >= 1) AND (octet_length(description_text) <= 1024)) AND (description_text ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (description_text !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c8
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((related_system_state = 'ABSENT'::text) AND (related_system_record_id IS NULL) AND (related_system_code_label IS NULL) AND (related_system_name_label IS NULL)) OR ((related_system_state = 'PRESENT_SAME_TENANT'::text) AND (related_system_record_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((octet_length(related_system_code_label) >= 1) AND (octet_length(related_system_code_label) <= 512)) AND (related_system_code_label ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (related_system_code_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND ((octet_length(related_system_name_label) >= 1) AND (octet_length(related_system_name_label) <= 512)) AND (related_system_name_label ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (related_system_name_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_c9
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((projection_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(gov_repo.frame_identity(ARRAY['GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_AGENT_PROJECTION_V1'::text, '1'::text, (organisation_id)::text, (source_record_id)::text, subject_id, projection_schema_version, handling_recipe_id, handling_recipe_version, document_recipe, agent_code_label, agent_name_label, (agent_type)::text,
CASE
    WHEN (business_domain_label IS NULL) THEN 'BUSINESS_DOMAIN_ABSENT'::text
    ELSE 'BUSINESS_DOMAIN_PRESENT'::text
END, COALESCE(business_domain_label, ''::text), description_disposition, COALESCE(description_text, ''::text), related_system_state, COALESCE((related_system_record_id)::text, ''::text), COALESCE(related_system_code_label, ''::text), COALESCE(related_system_name_label, ''::text)]), 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_f1
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organisation_id) REFERENCES gov_repo.organisations(organisation_id)

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id)

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_c1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((document_recipe = 'GOVIA_OPERATIONAL_CONTEXT_V1'::text) AND ((octet_length(projection_schema_version) >= 1) AND (octet_length(projection_schema_version) <= 512)) AND (projection_schema_version ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text) AND (projection_schema_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (lower(btrim(projection_schema_version)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND gov_repo.sr2_list_valid_v1(ARRAY[provider_id, model_id, model_version], 3) AND (lower(btrim(provider_id)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (lower(btrim(model_id)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (lower(btrim(model_version)) <> ALL (ARRAY['latest'::text, 'default'::text, 'unknown'::text]))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_c2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((dimension >= 1) AND (dimension <= 16000)) AND (vector_dims(embedding) = dimension)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_c3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((vector_norm(embedding) > (0)::double precision) AND (vector_norm(embedding) <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision]))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_c4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((representation_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(gov_repo.frame_identity(ARRAY['GOVIA_SR2_OPERATIONAL_AGENT_REPRESENTATION_V1'::text, (organisation_id)::text, (source_record_id)::text, observation_id, projection_schema_version, provider_id, model_id, model_version, (dimension)::text]), 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_c5
constraints.definition: CHECK (((isfinite(generated_at) AND isfinite(recorded_at) AND (generated_at <= recorded_at)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_f1
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id) REFERENCES gov_repo.sr2_operational_agent_observations_v1(organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id)

constraints.name: sr2_operational_agent_representations_v1_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (organisation_id, source_record_id, observation_id, projection_schema_version, provider_id, model_id, model_version, dimension, representation_id)
